```{r connect_to_data, include=FALSE}
con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "bikes_database.db")

# dbListTables(con)
 
bikes_tbl      <- tbl(con, "bikes")        
bikeshops_tbl  <- tbl(con, "bikeshops")
orderlines_tbl <- tbl(con, "orderlines")

# Join and transform using database backend, improving final product performance.  
pre_processed_data_tbl <- orderlines_tbl %>%
    left_join(bikeshops_tbl, by = c("customer.id" = "bikeshop.id")) %>%
    left_join(bikes_tbl, by = c("product.id" = "bike.id")) %>%
    mutate(extended_price = quantity * price) %>% 
    collect()
 
# Further transform data as needed in R, done because no SQL translation
# could be preformed on the backend with dbplyer.  
processed_data_tbl <- pre_processed_data_tbl %>%
    mutate(order.date = ymd(order.date)) %>% 
    separate(location, into = c("city", "state"), sep = ", ") %>%
    separate(description, into = c("category_1", "category_2", "frame_material"), sep = " - ") %>%
    select(order.date, order.id, order.line, state, quantity, price, extended_price, 
           category_1:frame_material, bikeshop.name)
remove(pre_processed_data_tbl)


# Close database connection.
dbDisconnect(con)
remove(con)
```






Column {.sidebar data-width=320}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r filters, echo=FALSE}
useShinyjs(rmd = TRUE)

# Date Range Select
dateRangeInput(inputId = "date_range",
               label   = h4("Date Range"),
               start   = min(processed_data_tbl$order.date),
               end     = max(processed_data_tbl$order.date),
               min = min(processed_data_tbl$order.date),
               max = max(processed_data_tbl$order.date),
               startview = "month")


# Category 1 Filter
shinyWidgets::checkboxGroupButtons(
    inputId   = "checkbox_category_1",
    label     = h4("Bike Type"),
    choices   = unique(processed_data_tbl$category_1),
    selected  = unique(processed_data_tbl$category_1),
    checkIcon = list(
        yes = icon("ok", lib = "glyphicon"),
        no  = icon("remove", lib = "glyphicon")
    ))

# Category 2 Filter
shinyWidgets::pickerInput(
    inputId  = "picker_category_2",
    label    = h4("Bike Family"),
    choices  = unique(processed_data_tbl$category_2),
    selected = unique(processed_data_tbl$category_2),
    multiple = TRUE,
    options = list(
        `actions-box` = TRUE,
        size = 10,
        `selected-text-format` = "count > 3"
    )
)

# Customer Filter
shinyWidgets::pickerInput(
    inputId = "picker_bikeshop_name",
    label = h4("Bike Shop (Customer)"),
    choices = unique(processed_data_tbl$bikeshop.name) %>% sort(),
    selected = unique(processed_data_tbl$bikeshop.name) %>% sort(),
    multiple = TRUE,
    options = list(
        `actions-box` = TRUE,
        size = 10,
        `selected-text-format` = "count > 1"
)
)


# Line Break
br()
# Horizontal Line
hr()
# Line Break
br()


# Forecast Mode ----


h4("Forecast Mode")
switchInput(inputId = "forecast_mode",
            value = FALSE,
            onStatus = "success",
            onLabel = "On",
            offLabel = "Off",
            handleWidth = 80,
            labelWidth = 80,
            inline = TRUE,
            width = "150px")

conditionalPanel(
    condition = "input.forecast_mode == 1",
    numericInput(inputId = "n_future",
                 label = "Forecast Horizion",
                 value = 12, 
                 min = 1))

br()
hr()
br()






# Apply and Reset ----

# Apply Button - GUI
actionButton(inputId = "apply",
             label = "Apply",
             icon = icon("play"))

# Apply Button - Action
# When a user hits this apply button, it will apply the filters selected.  

processed_data_filtered_tbl <- eventReactive(eventExpr = input$apply, 
              valueExpr = {
    processed_data_tbl %>% 
        filter(order.date %>% between(left = input$date_range[1], 
                                      right = input$date_range[2])) %>%
        filter(category_1 %in% input$checkbox_category_1) %>%
        filter(category_2 %in% input$picker_category_2) %>%
        filter(bikeshop.name %in% input$picker_bikeshop_name)
},
ignoreNULL = FALSE

)

# Reset Button - GUI
actionButton(inputId = "reset",
             label = "Reset",
             icon = icon("sync"))

# Reset Button - Action
# When user hits reset button, reset all filters to default.
observeEvent(eventExpr = input$reset, handlerExpr = {
    
    updateDateRangeInput(
        session = session,
        inputId = "date_range",
        start = min(processed_data_tbl$order.date),
        end = max(processed_data_tbl$order.date))
    
    
    updateCheckboxGroupButtons(
        session = session,
        inputId = "checkbox_category_1",
        selected = unique(processed_data_tbl$category_1))
    
    updatePickerInput(
        session = session,
        inputId = "picker_category_2",
        selected = unique(processed_data_tbl$category_2)
    )
    
    updatePickerInput(
        session = session,
        inputId = "picker_bikeshop_name",
        selected = unique(processed_data_tbl$bikeshop.name) %>% sort()
    )
    
    
    updateRadioGroupButtons(
    session = session,
  inputId   = "time_unit",
  label     = "Time Unit",
  choices   = c("Daily"     = "day",
                "Weekly"    = "week",
                "Monthly"   = "month",
                "Quarterly" = "quarter",
                "Yearly"    = "year"),
  selected  = "month",
  status    = "primary",
  justified = TRUE,
  checkIcon = list(yes = icon(name = "check",
                              lib  = "glyphicon"),
                   no  = icon(name = "remove-circle",
                              lib  = "glyphicon")))
    
    
    updateSwitchInput(
        session = session,
        inputId = "forecast_mode",
        value = FALSE
    )
    
    updateNumericInput(
        session = session,
        inputId = "n_future",
        value = 12
    )
    
  shinyjs::delay(ms = 300, expr = {
      shinyjs::click(id = "apply")})
      
})



# View Mode
br()
hr()
br()
h5("View Mode")
switchInput(inputId = "view_mode",
            value = TRUE,
            onStatus = "success",
            offStatus = "primary",
            onLabel = "Light",
            offLabel = "Dark",
            handleWidth = 80,
            labelWidth = 80,
            inline = TRUE,
            width = "150px")

```

```{r}
summary_values_tbl <- reactive({
  
  processed_data_filtered_tbl() %>%
  
    summarize(
      health_metric = unique(order.id) %>% length(),
      wealth_metric = sum(extended_price),
      wise_metric   = (sum(str_detect(category_1, "Mountain")) / (sum(str_detect(category_1, "Road")) + 0.0001)) %>% 
        round(1)
    ) 
})

# renderPrint(summary_values_tbl())

```

### Health

```{r}
renderValueBox({
  
  valueBox(
    value   = summary_values_tbl()$health_metric %>% scales::comma(), 
    caption = "Orders", 
    icon    = "fa-heartbeat", 
    color   = case_when(summary_values_tbl()$health_metric < 200 ~ "danger",
                        summary_values_tbl()$health_metric < 500 ~ "warning",
                        TRUE ~ "success"))
  
})


```


### Wealthy

```{r}
renderValueBox({
  
  valueBox(
    value   = summary_values_tbl()$wealth_metric %>% scales::dollar(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M", accuracy = 0.1), 
    caption = "Sales", 
    icon    = "fa-money-check-alt", 
    color   = case_when(summary_values_tbl()$wealth_metric < 5e6 ~ "danger",
                        summary_values_tbl()$wealth_metric < 50e6 ~ "warning",
                        TRUE ~ "success"))
  
})
```


### Wise

```{r}
renderValueBox({
  
  valueBox(
    value   = summary_values_tbl()$wise_metric, 
    caption = "Ratio, Mountain to Road", 
    icon    = "fa-brain", 
    color   = case_when(summary_values_tbl()$wise_metric < 0.5 ~ "warning",
                        summary_values_tbl()$wise_metric < 2.0 ~ "success",
                        TRUE ~ "warning"))
  
})
```

```{r data_prep_choropleth_map, echo=FALSE}
# Choropleth Map using the "ploty" library.


geo_plot_tbl <- reactive({
    processed_data_filtered_tbl() %>%
    group_by(state) %>%
    summarise(total_revenue = sum(extended_price)) %>%
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(label_text = str_glue("State: {state}
                                 Revenue: {scales::dollar(total_revenue)}"))
    
})
```

```{r map, echo=FALSE}
output$plotly_1 <- renderPlotly(expr = {
  geo_plot_tbl() %>%
    plot_geo(locationmode = "USA-states") %>%
    add_trace(z = ~total_revenue,
              locations = ~state,
              color = ~total_revenue,
              text = ~label_text,
              colors = "Reds",
              legendgroup = "Total Revenue") %>%
    layout(
      geo = list(
        scope = "usa",
        projection = list(type = "albers usa"),
        showlakes = FALSE,
        lakecolor = toRGB("blue"),
        legend = list(title = "My Legend Title")
      )
    )
})

plotlyOutput(outputId = "plotly_1")
```

### Over Time


```{r}
shinyWidgets::radioGroupButtons(
  inputId   = "time_unit", 
  label     = "Time Unit",
  choices   = c("Daily"     = "day", 
                "Weekly"    = "week", 
                "Monthly"   = "month", 
                "Quarterly" = "quarter", 
                "Yearly"    = "year"),  
  selected  = "month",
  status    = "success", 
  justified = TRUE, 
  checkIcon = list(yes = icon(name = "check", 
                              lib  = "glyphicon"),
                   no  = icon(name = "remove-circle", 
                              lib  = "glyphicon")))

observeEvent(eventExpr = input$time_unit, {
    
    if (input$forecast_mode) {
        delay(300, click(id = "apply"))
    }
})

observeEvent(eventExpr = input$forecast_mode, {
    delay(300, click(id = "apply"))
    }, once = TRUE)

```


```{r sales_over_time, echo=FALSE}



# Reactive Data Table
time_plot_tbl <- reactive({
    
   processed_data_filtered_tbl() %>% 
        aggregate_time_series(time_unit = input$time_unit)
    
})

time_plot_predicitions_tbl <- eventReactive(eventExpr = input$apply, {
    
    if (input$forecast_mode) {
        time_plot_tbl() %>%
            generate_forecast(n_future = input$n_future, seed = 123)
        
    }
})

# Time Plot

output$plotly_2 <- renderPlotly({
    
    if (input$forecast_mode) {
      p <-   time_plot_predicitions_tbl() %>%
            plot_forecast()
        
    } else {
     p <-    time_plot_tbl() %>%
            plot_time_series()
        
    }
    
    p %>%
        layout(margin = list(b = 200))
    
})

plotlyOutput(outputId = "plotly_2")
```
